profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary:
Masters of Science in Computer Science From Vanderbilt University (Graduated August 2024)
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science From Lenoir-Rhyne University (Graduated May 2022)
Bachelor of Arts in Information Technology From Lenoir-Rhyne University (Graduated May 2022)
Graduated Summa Cum Laude with Program Honors and Honors Academy From Lenoir-Rhyne University
IT Data Integrations Dev - CPM at Alex Lee Inc. (May 2022 - Current)

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Developed SSRS & SSIS packages 
•	Wrote SQL scripts on developer and production databases
•	Migrated code from COBOL mainframe to SQL server database
•	Various integration projects defined by business requests

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor/Course Assistant
positions.description:
•	Tutor students at the Mathematics and Computer Science tutoring center at Lenoir-Rhyne University 
•	Course Assistant for advanced Java programming in Spring 2022
•	Paid role through the University

positions.title: SSRS/SSIS Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed SSRS & SSIS packages 
•	Wrote SQL scripts on developer and production databases
•	Migrated code from COBOL mainframe to SQL server database

positions.title: Veterinary Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assisted in aspects of everyday veterinary technician jobs, such as controlling pets, providing client billing, resolving customer issues and other ad-hoc staff functions.
•	Resolved IT problems as required

positions.title: Boston Saw & Tool Project
positions.description:
•	Created and designed commercial website for Boston Saw & Tool
•	Integrated and migrated legacy emails to a new web hosting service
•      Can be seen at www.bostonsawandtool.com

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Baseball coach for 17U regional travel team
•	Exercised leadership and guidance through practices
•	Promoted sportsmanship along with competitive play
•	Community outreaches on social media
•	Charitable work through 501(c)(3) - Boston Charitable Athletics
•       Involves 400 hours per season of volunteer work

•	Assisted with therapeutic riding for special needs children and adults
•	Guided and helped communicate needs of special needs children
•	Involves 80 hours per year of volunteer work
